title: Exact counterfeiting oracle (W1)
caption: Game W1 (Wiesner simple 1->2 counterfeiting, exact projective verifier, no oracle). Solid line: MVW 2012 Theorem 1 optimum (3/4)^n, evaluated by qmint.proofs.ideal_bounds. Grey dashed: (3/4+sqrt2/8)^n is the optimum of the DIFFERENT classical-verification game W1_CV (MVW Theorem 2) and is not a bound for W1. Blue circles: Monte Carlo success of the optimal MVW channel attack (lane C, 10^4 independent notes per n, Clopper-Pearson 95%), a lower bound on the worst case. Diamonds: Choi-matrix SDP optimum for n=1,2 with a certified bracket [exact achieving channel, exact-rational dual upper bound]; right panel shows the bracket width. Lane D re-verified the upper bounds independently (proofs/certificates/reproduction_v1.json). n>=3 SDP: UNSUPPORTED (size guard); no large-n numerical extrapolation is drawn.
legend: [THEOREM] W1_CV (3/4+sqrt2/8)^n - DIFFERENT GAME (classical verification), MVW Thm 2
[SDP] certified bracket [exact lower, certified upper], n=1,2
[MC] optimal MVW channel attack, 95% CP (lane C)
[SDP] exact rational LDL^T dual (lane C), re-verified by lane D
